Fixture for tests/test_dcs_gate.py, criterion 5c (halt-loop-unbounded
period 1 revision 2) -- a log written entirely in the PRE-v0.6.9 grammar:
old-style "IAP approved by Owner, hash=..." and "SAFETY: halt --" text,
no `IAP-APPROVED:` / `SAFETY-HALT:` / `SAFETY-PASS:` sentinel anywhere.
halt_cycles() on this file must return 0, not 10: the new grammar's ten
"SAFETY: halt" lines don't match HALT_RE at all (no hyphen, no colon in
that position), no anchor matches either, and "no anchor matched -> count
from the top of the file" for a pre-existing log always means zero,
because SAFETY-HALT: itself is new. This is what keeps every in-flight
incident and every npm consumer's existing 214-LOG.md from being walled
on first contact with the upgraded hook.

Kept under its own name rather than deleted: it is a period's own
uncommitted product (not historical evidence), but its role changed from
"ten-halts" to a criterion-5c legacy fixture, hence legacy-no-sentinel/.
Do not edit; add a new fixture directory instead.
-->
